data.other_sector: Electrical connectors, Molex connector, Optical fiber connectors, Switches
data.skills:
Designing and supporting high speed electrical interconnects 
Experience with available CAD/CAE tools such as Channel Designer, HFSS, CST, FDTD tools, MoM tools, Sigrity PowerSI, PAKSI-E, Power-grid, Agilent ADS, Agilent PLTS, Cadence CAD tools 
Experience correlating simulation results with lab measurements using oscilloscopes, TDRs and VNAs is essential. Capability of scripting/automating the analysis flow with point tool
data.eligibility_information: Masters or PhD in microwave engineering or equivalent
data.additional_information:
DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:
Perform characterization of high-speed connectors and systems through the use of high-speed digital testing and electromagnetic modelling techniques. 
Develop empirical and analytical electrical test procedures and specifications. Perform testing based on available design input requirements 
Design characterization test boards and customer verification boards; work with PCB design houses. 
Provide PCB routing guidance to customers to maintain signal integrity performance while adhering to the customers preferred PCB technologies and DFM rules.  
Generate evaluation and qualification reports or presentation materials for both internal and customer use. 
Provide expert advice to Marketing, Sales and/or customers on signal integrity related matters. 
Lead research and development work on or advanced technologies in electrical design capabilities. 
May be assigned to lead and manage the overall performance of the Signal Integrity function. 
Drive innovative and challenging concepts for interconnect design breakthrough. 
Other duties as assigned by Management.

TECHNICAL RESPONSIBILITIES 
Participate in Industry Standards Committee or Association activities. 
Provide technical training on Signal Integrity to Product Design Engineering, Marketing and Sales personnel or others as required. 
Prepare and conduct technical presentations to Sales, Marketing and/or Customers. 
Be up to date with Industry trend on high-speed interconnect technologies that includes Silicon, package, hardware, system architecture, etc. and share information among team members. 
Involved with industrial co-development for next generation IO/platform/signaling/interconnect enabling. 
Academia collaboration (research papers/PHD programs)
PSR filing and Technical papers publication (IEEE/Design Conn) annually.
